stemMd: A document archive occupies 2.4 square metres of floor space. How many square centimetres is that?
explanationMd: A metre contains 100 centimetres, so a square metre contains 10,000 square centimetres. Multiply 2.4 by 10,000.

distractorRationale.b: Uses a factor of 1000 rather than 100 squared.
distractorRationale.d: Adds an extra factor of ten.
distractorRationale.a: Uses the linear conversion factor for an area.
